# DX Foundation (DX Foundation, LLC)
> Salesforce, Data Cloud, and AI consulting focused on future-ready digital experiences (CX/UX/ITX).

## Primary topics (what this site covers)
- Salesforce implementations and optimization (Sales, Service, Marketing, Financial Services Cloud)
- Agentforce strategy, implementation, and adoption
- AI for Salesforce: agent design, reliability, topic design, latency, and governance-ready patterns
- Data 360 / Data Cloud foundations: unification, architecture, pipelining, analytics
- Managed services + health scans + continuous improvement
- Rescue & remediation for stalled Salesforce initiatives
- Technology strategy, technology implementation, and M&A technology integration
